instruction: Turn on the equalizer and switch it to the Rock preset.

criteria.script: async () => { const data = await window.surfgym.get_configs({ criteria: [ { file: '.config/vlc/vlcrc', format: 'key_value', key: 'audio-filter', default: '' } ] }); return data[0]; }
async () => { const data = await window.surfgym.get_configs({ criteria: [ { file: '.config/vlc/vlcrc', format: 'key_value', key: 'equalizer-preset', default: 'flat' } ] }); return data[0]; }
